semiconductor_relevance: High — Ernst & Engbring GmbH specializes in custom PTFE laminated flat cables specifically designed for the semiconductor industry, particularly in cleanroom and vacuum environments.
summary: Ernst & Engbring GmbH develops and manufactures highly flexible customized PTFE cable slabs tailored for the semiconductor sector. Their products are engineered for high-demand applications where low particulation and long flex life are critical.
capabilities: Highly flexible cable slabs for cleanroom environments
